business_summary: G.I. Tech Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells special-purpose machinery products in South Korea, the United States, China, and internationally. The company offers horizontal, vertical, t-bar manual adjustment, t-bar semi-auto adjustment, and WC slot dies; slit nozzles; and air knives. It also provides coating and laminating machines; and repair services. In addition, the company engages in the machine vision business comprising surface/pattern inspection, 3D/displacement measurement, EL/optical inspection, and RAVID software; and environmental business, including advanced oxidation/decomposition, electrodialysis reversal, operating cost reduction, and regulatory compliance/safety. G.I. Tech Co., Ltd. was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Asan-si, South Korea.
